description:
HI,

I hope you are doing good.

I have a job opportunity related to your profile with one of our client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested and available for the following position then please send your updated resume in word format along with your contact details to discuss further.

 Role: Technology Analyst - Agile Developer (Java, Angular/Node JS, TDD)
Duration: Full Time / Permanent
Location: Pleasanton, CA

Qualifications 
Basic 
• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
• At least 2 years of experience with Information Technology

 Preferred 
• At least 3 years of experience with Angular JS, Node JS and Ruby with core Java and CI/CD with Jenkins and Chef 
• At least 2 years of experience in development in Agile with strong knowledge for TDD with exposure to any/all of following tools: JUnit/Mockito/Cucumber/JMeter/Pact/Sonar. 
• Knowledge of Micro Services Architecture and Spring Cloud
• At least 3 years of experience in software development life cycle. 
• At least 1 years of experience in translating functional/non-functional requirements to system requirements.
• Experience in Retail Supply Chain with functional knowledge of Planning and/or Order Management is a plus
• Experience and understanding of Production support and performance engineering.
• Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
• Analytical skills 
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment


 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
